ceu: ✦ The trine between Venus and Jupiter

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.
From {H:1801156876000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your horizons and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
With Mars retrograde in your daily routine sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to your partner or to a close friend.

t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.
From {H:1801156876000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to relationships and partnerships.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, intimacy and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Let things flow without forcing them.
With Mars retrograde in your romance sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Swap a snack for fruit and notice how you feel.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.
From {H:1801156876000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to routine, daily work and health.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, relationships and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
With Mars retrograde in your home and family sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Dance at home, even if it is just to one song.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.
From {H:1801156876000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, routine and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
With Mars retrograde in your communication sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Open the windows in the morning and let fresh air into your home.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.
From {H:1801156876000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to home and family.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, romance and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
With Mars retrograde in your money sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Before reacting to a message, read it twice.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.
From {H:1801156876000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, family and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
With Mars retrograde in your self-image sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Think of a way to make one of your talents pay off.

t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.
From {H:1801156876000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, conversations and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
With Mars retrograde in your inner life sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Start something new today, however small.

t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.
From {H:1801156876000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to your image and your personal energy.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, money and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
With Mars retrograde in your friendship sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Spend five minutes in silence before going to sleep.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.
From {H:1801156876000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to rest and your inner life.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your image and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
With Mars retrograde in your career sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Write down a dream and three steps to get there.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.
From {H:1801156876000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your inner life and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. An idea from today could become a real project.
With Mars retrograde in your horizons sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Set aside an hour without interruptions for what matters most.

t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.
From {H:1801156876000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, friendships and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
With Mars retrograde in your intimacy sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Teach someone something you know well.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.
From {H:1801156876000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your career and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
With Mars retrograde in your relationships sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Review debts, loans or shared accounts calmly.
